description.text: The first set of the Mega Evolution series, from the game Pokémon Legends: Z-A, released on 26 September 2025 with 132 cards plus secret rares. It brought back Mega Evolution as Mega Evolution Pokémon ex, nearly a dozen of them, led by Mega Lucario ex and Mega Gardevoir ex: they hit hard and have high HP, but give up three Prize cards when Knocked Out. It also brought in ultra rare versions of Items, Pokémon Tools and Stadiums.
